body:
I get piss tested twice a week randomly and so have gone onto legal drugs and or drugs my program doesn't test for. I usually robotrip (its actually more like trolling) on a full 4oz bottle of robotussin dm and it kicks in about an hour after taking (i just down a bottle) last time i took it on a saturday at about 4pm and tripped until about 8:30pm and got piss tested on monday at about 5pm. my test came back negative for opiates, pcp, and ethly alcohol.
I love robo tripping and recomend it for everyone who does drugs recreationally. Robotripping makes you fell like your on ecstacy and on shrooms at the same time. You want to be touched or massaged like ecstacy and you want to hug everyone and tell them how much u love them, and also its very hard to focus, like if you were to turn your head to the left it would be like swinging a camera very fast to the left and having to stop it(your view) from swingin and move it back to the center, also my face got very pale and my eyes got really big. my cheeks were flushed however. it's very obvious to others that your on drugs while robotripping it's not like pot where you can still act relativly normal and just say your tired or hungry. also i couldnt eat while robotripping i had a complete lack of all appetite. saying things like elongated s's were very fun and amusing to say i kept saying 'ssssssstupid cccccccynthia' (s's were fun to say and cynthia's my counselor and i dont like her so i thought i'd combine the two) also i was a little paranoid going into public places since it's extremely obvious your on something when robotripping you also dont walk right. you tend to walk rather rigid like a robot or something, any ways i love robotripping and plan to keep on robotripping long after i get piss tested! enjoy! and i hope this info comes of use to erowid!!!
